results.description:
This audiobook is narrated by an AI Voice. Learn French anytime, anywhere — while you sleep, drive, walk, study, or work out.

1000 Words is your calm and immersive way to master French through audio. Each episode helps you expand your vocabulary, improve pronunciation, and understand real French — without stress, screens, or interruptions.

In this audiobook, you’ll hear 1000 essential French nouns, clearly spoken with English translations. Perfect for beginners, travelers, and language lovers who want to absorb French naturally through repeated listening.

Listen in bed, at the gym, in the car, or during your daily routine — every minute helps you grow your French effortlessly.

Relax. Focus. Learn French anywhere. For more content, games and exclusive video lessons, visit ⁠1000-words.com⁠.
